# Goal
Souji round 25, wave 1 (build + first falsifiers). Lane: fleet repository & workspace hygiene (掃除). Axes: calibration (7, lowest), operability (8), coverage (8); no axis may be harmed. Claims frozen in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-25/preregistration.txt at lane commit 6e4737eab43d8fde1b85eb9f57023d29046705b4 (branch master, ahead=0): C1 kill-rule tool row (calibration), C2 size-census refusal surfaces covered (operability), C3 structure probe under the common-git-dir envelope + colocated/plain precondition (coverage). Lane base for after-runs: a6d2d157755ef36b1dd4b9d53ad6d5b2ad6a3afe. The L1 holds the planner seat and is the only integrator.

# HARD BOUND (violating this voids your seat)
souji is a hygiene lane, but its write scope is its own repo only. **Never delete, move, quarantine or classify-for-cleanup anything in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin outside /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin/.** Incident 2026-10-25: the fleet's tracked .scratch/ tree was deleted mid-run by an unidentified seat. Never touch /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/.scratch/, /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/.ufo/state/, /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/.ufo/watchdog.log, MANIFEST.json, the fleet scripts/ or templates/, any sibling lane repo, the lane's jj state or git index, or /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokuknow (read-only source: never write, commit, fetch, push or run a campaign tool there).

# Contract
- Read /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-25/preregistration.txt FIRST. It is the frozen counter contract (claims C1/C2/C3, case sets, kill rules, after targets). Never propose changing a predicate, target or case set as if it were allowed after data: if you believe a counter is wrong or gameable, report it as an ATTACK.
- READ-ONLY seats (scout, reviewer, critic, connector, sentinel, mutation-tester): write ONLY your own report inside your rendered Report: path; no edits to lane files except your own report file; no `git add/commit/push/stash/checkout/reset`, no `jj` mutation, no `rm`/`mv` of anything you did not create, no signals. Read-only `git log/show/diff/status/ls-tree/cat-file/rev-parse` against the lane are fine.
- EXECUTOR seats: write ONLY the draft file(s) your item names (under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-25/w1/) and your own report. Never edit tools/, tests/, corpus/, census/, SCORECARD.md, LOG.md, SOURCES.md in place — the L1 integrates drafts. No git/jj mutations. A fixture may run against committed tools at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin/tools/; a draft tool may be run from the wave dir.
- Scratch goes ONLY under `/var/tmp/souji-r25-<YourName>/` (never /tmp); any git repo you need is created there with `git init`; remove your scratch before you finish.
- Absolute paths only. Your tools start at the FLEET root, not the lane: every lane path must be written as /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin/<path>. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin/<that path>. A relative path lands in the wrong repo.
- A source claim needs a location: URL or repo path plus line/section, and a <=25-word verbatim quote copied from bytes you opened this run, containing no literal or escaped `|`.
- Unrun checks have not passed. Never report an execution you did not perform; label inference as `[INFERENCE]`. Run lane Python with `python3 -B` (no __pycache__ in the lane).
- Tooling is authorized (operator 2026-10-19): you may install or upgrade tools that help the task; read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first (official channels only, record tool/version/channel/reason in your report). **pacman guard: all pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide** — install via `uv tool`/`npx`/an official binary in `~/.local/bin`, or route around it. Never run `pacman -S/-Sy/-Syu/-U/-R`, never downgrade, never restart a host service.
- Certification OFF, K5 HELD, F5 reap + NAMESPACE holds unchanged. No credentials, no live /proc census, no `census/operator-sweep-*` contents, no `.scratch/` contents. Never `agent://all`.

# Output shape
Markdown report at your rendered `Report:` path: `## Status` (one line `STATUS: PASS|PARTIAL|FAIL` + why), `## Evidence` (command, output excerpt, revision), `## Findings` (numbered, each with its location), `## Attack log` where your item is an attack or falsification. Terse; no filler. For executors, also name the draft file(s) you wrote and the exact commands that prove the red/green arms.
